sloka: नदीं बाहुसहस्रेण रुन्धन्तमरिमर्दनम् ।गिरिं पादसहस्रेण रुन्धन्तमिव मेदिनीम् ।। ७.३२.१५ ॥
transliteration: nadīṁ bāhusahasreṇa rundhantamarimardanam ।giriṁ pādasahasreṇa rundhantamiva medinīm ।। 7.32.15 ॥

translations.english: He was obstructing the river with his thousand arms, like a mountain with a thousand feet obstructing the earth, a true destroyer of enemies.
